note: Levels for the jump sounds (scripts/jump_audio.gd). Volumes in dB, pitch as a multiplier. PLACEHOLDERS to be tuned by ear after playing: hum_*: the drive's idle at the start and at full spool; whine_max_*: the rising tone at full streak; rush_max_db: the noise of the stars going by; boom/engage/settle: one-shot levels.
